clue.text: Parisian who probes top lunch where food's lacking

clue.text: Expert reformed zoo in little time, shortly relating to primitive life

cut short, so the final letter of the time word goes

clue.text: What's left side when cycling into Champs Elysees?

clue.text: Back-to-back vermouths consumed by card player — most droll

clue.text: Exit needed for one unopened lock

clue.text: Unknown tucks in regularly on promo for this bean

clue.text: Although getting married in USA, perversely Dave's partner comes later
